scope: Static source review of the conditional CPU score-admission V4 template, renderer, and binding plan. No import, test, renderer execution, B query/action, score launch, payload read, or quality evaluation was performed.

source_contract.export_acceptance_and_exact_stop: UNBOUND; actual receipt pins are null in the plan

findings.finding: The preflight requires the original AllThree LAUNCH.json to contain a top-level invocation_id equal to 94d3a7132a434d448345b0206bd3daa3. The exact pinned original LAUNCH receipt has no top-level invocation_id; its invocation is in the captured systemctl_after_submission.stdout_b64 properties.
findings.impact: After all fresh read-only gates, the score preflight will always reject the valid original receipt before staging. The export V4 admission already demonstrates the correct nested systemctl property join.

findings.finding: The renderer opens EXPORT_SOURCE_REVIEW_V1.json under first_cell_evaluation_export_v2, but that directory contains EXPORT_SOURCE_REVIEW_V2.json. The binding plan and V4 fixtures also name V2.
findings.impact: The renderer will fail with a missing-file error even after the admission receipt-shape defect is repaired. The renderer's review path and its exact pinned review filename must match the durable V2 source review.
